"use client"

import type { SignShape } from "@/lib/0db/sign-shapes"

    [

        13,

      ]
    ],
    [

        "M",
        13,
        21
      ],
      [
        "L",
        11,
        13
      ]
    ],
    [
      [
        "M",
        11,
        13
      ],
      [
        "L",
        3,
        11
      ]
    ]

}

function SignNavigationWords(props: Omit<SignProps, "shape" | "variant">) {
  return <Sign shape={shape} variant="words" {...props} />
}

export { SignNavigationWords, shape }
